body_baseline.description: 原向盒底朝下，獨立移到Z0。

body_candidate.description: 繞全局Y正90°側放；原臂長+Z轉世界+X，原彎曲+Y仍為世界+Y，兩方向平行XY。僅幾何方向條件，未驗層間強度。

lid_baseline.description: 原向蓋裙／凸緣低面落床；大蓋板底面仍高於床面。

lid_candidate.description: 以自身原點繞全局X180°翻面，使原板頂面朝床；蓋裙／凸緣朝上，仍須檢查局部朝下面。Object Location不等同world剛體translation。

native_analysis_scope.angle_definition: Outward polygon normal to world negative Z: horizontal down=0 degrees, vertical=90, up=180.
native_analysis_scope.range_role: Tutor-chosen display range only; not a printer, material or support acceptance angle.
native_analysis_scope.native_readback: Actual RNA radians/degrees and Edit Mode overlay settings plus original screenshots.
native_analysis_scope.derived_statistics: Polygon and loop-triangle angles/areas/counts are independent reconstructions, not counts supplied by the native panel and not sampled GPU colours.
native_analysis_scope.boundary_handling: Faces within 1e-4 degree of the display boundaries are listed separately; the band does not widen the native remap.
native_analysis_scope.minimum_saturation: Below Minimum saturates to weight 1; above Maximum maps to -1/gray; exact Maximum maps to 0.

bed_reference.description: 僅以世界XY網格作Z0基準；未指定機型、床幅、切片原點或實體平台。
bed_reference.epsilon_role: 浮點落床讀值核對，不是製造公差或附著合格值。

dimensions_context.note: The native N-panel retains the object-axis dimensions after an unapplied rotation. World X/Y/Z bounds/spans in this manifest come from evaluated world vertices, not a direct reading of N-panel Dimensions.
dimensions_context.object_location_vs_rigid_translation: Lid origin is not world zero: Object Location and the affine world translation that maps the source vertices are different quantities; each pose retains both through raw CAD metadata and measured pose data.

limitations: Geometric parallelism to the layer plane does not prove layer adhesion, allowable strain, fatigue life or strength.
Bed-contact downward faces and non-bed-contact downward faces are separate groups; local face angle alone does not determine support.
The world Z0 reference is not a machine bed capacity/origin/adhesion check.
No bridge span, previous-layer support, support-removal access, slicer support generation, printing or physical fit was checked.
The known 0.4 mm nozzle does not determine material, line width, angle threshold, clearance, strain or strength.
